text:
tyler: Heads-up — Grafana alert just fired for hosted-usw2 GPU cluster: p95 admission latency > 1.2s over 5m and queue length trending up. Not a full outage but enough to impact SLAs. @oncall-sre can you grab this? :eyes:

ops-bot: [ALERT] hosted-usw2: hosted_gpu_pool_admission_p95 > 1.2s (5m). Alert ID: A-224678. See https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/hosted-usw2

rika: I'm on it. Looking at pool metrics now — admission_rate spike ~+18% vs baseline, pool7 showing backlog. No deploys in last 2h per deploybot.

chris: Any sign of KV cache missstorm or new model variants getting pinned? Those usually cause transient queueing.

jess: Quick Prom query (5m window) — the hotspots are pool7 and pool9. PromQL I ran: ```
sum by(pool) (rate(hosted_gpu_requests_queue_length[5m]))
```
Results: pool7=42, pool9=36 (baseline ~12/15). Also seeing model-preload failures ~0.8% which is above normal.

tyler: interesting — we rolled a preload tweak last night (smaller batch preload) to reduce memory pressure. Could be backfiring on cold-starts.

rika: I'm going to bump admission throttle for hosted-usw2 by +10% temporarily to ease queuing while we triage. If that moves latency back to normal we can plan a safer config rollback.

jess: Patch command I'm going to run (will run in canary): ```
# patch admission config for region
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/configs/admission -d '{"region":"usw2","throttle_pct":110}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN"
```
I'll run it for 15m and monitor.

ops-bot: Runbook: "Reduce queueing by temporary throttle relaxation" started by rika at 2246789075. Playbook link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/queueing-relaxation

oncall-sre: Heads-up on cost: relaxing admission will push more requests through GPUs and could increase short-term cost ~5-8% if sustained. Also consider enabling the smaller-model fallback for non-enterprise customers to reduce unit GPU time.

chris: I'll open a routing tweak to prefer eu-west spillover when us-west pools exceed 80% utilization — low risk change. Rolling it to 10% of traffic first.

tyler: Sounds good. Owners: rika (throttle canary + monitor), jess (prom queries + rollback script), chris (spillover route change), oncall-sre (coord cost/SLAs). ETA 15m for initial impact check.

rika: Canary applied at 2246789089. Monitoring dashboards: p95, queue length, model-preload-errors, GPU-util. Will report in 10m. :thumbsup:

jess: After 8m: p95 trending down from 1.45s -> 0.98s, pool7 queue from 42 -> 16. Model-preload-errors steady at 0.8%. Looks like throttle tweak helped.

oncall-sre: Good. Keep the tweak for 30m, then rollback to previous value and schedule a follow-up to address preload failures. Cost estimate for 30m at current rate: +3.5% spend for region.

tyler: Filing follow-up ticket for preload investigation and long-term mitigations (cache warming, preload success alerts, model fallback routing). Thanks everyone.

chris: Created ticket INFRA-4124: "usw2 preload failures -> investigate model warmup and admission interplay" and linked this thread.

ops-bot: Runbook closed by rika at 2246789148 — Canary successful, manual rollback scheduled after 30m hold.

tyler: closing loop: monitoring will keep an eye for 2 hours; if we see re-escalation we escalate to oncall pager. Great job. :tada:
